chain.label: Contaminated/mixed-condition runway
chain.trigger: runway 31C braking action reports were mixed, reporting good or fair braking action for the first half of the runway and poor braking action for the second half

chain.label: Tailwind exceeding poor-braking limit
chain.trigger: the actual crosswind component at touchdown was between 8 and 9 knots

chain.label: Incomplete ATC braking action relay
chain.trigger: the controller did not provide the accident pilots with a report obtained from the pilot of a smaller airplane that described the braking action as poor, as required

chain.label: SWA guidance/training gap
chain.trigger: Southwest Airlines did not provide its pilots with clear and consistent guidance and training regarding company policies and procedures related to arrival landing distance calculations

chain.label: OPC hid tailwind/reverse-thrust assumptions
chain.trigger: the OPC displays the stopping margin associated with the maximum tailwind limit rather than the actual tailwind component ... programming and design of its on board performance computer, which did not present inherent assumptions

chain.label: Pilots misjudged true stopping margin
chain.trigger: the pilots were not aware of at least two underlying OPC assumptions, neither of which was displayed on the OPC

caused_by.evidence: if the pilots had been presented with stopping margins associated with the input winds ... the pilots may have elected to divert
SWA did not provide its pilots with clear and consistent guidance and training ... regarding company policies and procedures

chain.label: Pilots elected to land rather than divert
chain.trigger: the pilots' failure to divert to another airport given reports that included poor braking action and a tailwind component greater than 5 knots

caused_by.evidence: braking action reported good for the first half, poor for the second half
reported wind conditions resulted in a computed tailwind component of 8 knots
pilots may have elected to divert
controller did not provide ... a report ... describing the braking action as poor, as required

chain.label: First-ever autobrake use, no familiarization period
chain.trigger: the accident landing was the first time either pilot landed using autobrakes

chain.label: Delayed thrust reverser deployment
chain.trigger: the pilots' first experience and lack of familiarity with the airplane's autobrake system distracted them from thrust reverser usage during the challenging landing

caused_by.evidence: pilots' first experience and lack of familiarity with the airplane's autobrake system distracted them from thrust reverser usage

chain.label: Runway overrun
chain.trigger: the airplane ran off the departure end of runway 31C

chain.label: Undersized runway safety area, no EMAS
chain.trigger: the runway 31C RSA extended 82 feet beyond the end of the runway and was 500 feet wide

chain.label: Airplane struck automobile off airport property
chain.trigger: the airplane rolled through a blast fence, an airport perimeter fence, and onto an adjacent roadway, where it struck an automobile

caused_by.evidence: the airplane ran off the departure end of runway 31C and continued through the runway safety area ... a blast fence ... an airport perimeter fence, and onto an adjacent public roadway
